== Course of events ==

After the Guardian of the Gates admits the companions again and locks the green spectacles onto their eyes, and after Toto knocks over a screen that reveals Oz to be only a little old bald man rather than a terrible being, each companion returns to the others believing he has truly gained what he sought. Left alone in the aftermath, Oz privately admits to himself that he is a humbug. His private admission is accompanied by worry: he has no idea how to send Dorothy back to Kansas.

This moment of solitary self-reckoning precedes Oz's subsequent efforts to satisfy the other companions. Afterward, he cuts a hole in the Tin Woodman's chest and inserts a silk heart stuffed with sawdust before soldering the patch shut, gives the Cowardly Lion a green liquid from a bottle and tells him to drink it as courage, and removes the Scarecrow's head to fill it with bran mixed with pins and needles before reattaching it.
